separation_rule: a LANE MODEL is what the declared pool says must serve a role (arm + rank + transport). A SESSION MODEL is what answers the human in this chat. They are independent: the session may be deepseek-v4.1-flash while every governance decision must still come from the PLAN lane. Nothing may promote a session answer into a lane verdict - that is what mandate_gate.py audit exists to catch.
low_friction_solution: one flag: --identity-source {relay-usage,codex-rollout} (no new subsystem, no new file format)
one default: run_lane relay base carries /v1
one transport shim, disclosed and retirable, for the provider whose keys the proxies hold wrong
no change to the mandate, the pool schema, or the receipt contract
